name: Rubber×Lovers
source:
One day in late August, students at the Hichisuko Private Academy (a.k.a. Pichisu Academy) were preparing for the school's cultural festival.

The head of the science club, Shino Fujiyama, developed an instant rubber suit attachment system for the class performance of a spy drama. 

When she tested the system, she forgot to implement the function allowing for zipper generation! Shino is now forced to wear the rubber suit throughout the entire school day.

Naturally, the students and teachers are unable to endure the eroticism of the rubber suit, especially as it accentuates Shino's figure....

translation:
八月下旬的一天，私立比奇苏子学园（又名比奇苏学园）的学生们正在为学校的文化节做准备。

科学俱乐部的负责人藤山诗乃为间谍剧的课堂表演开发了一种即时橡胶套装附着系统。

当她测试系统时，她忘记实现允许拉链生成的功能！诗乃现在被迫全天穿着橡胶套装。

当然，学生和老师们都无法忍受橡胶套装的色情，尤其是它凸显了诗乃的身材……
